name: Furano (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Furano city emblem in navy: a ring pierced by a large triangle pointing to the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Furano, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 October 1966.

features.role: Furano city emblem — a ring pierced by a large triangle pointing to the lower fly
